title: PriceProposalExtraction
description: Structured output schema for Spanish electricity price-proposal extraction. Matches the producto-based contract consumed by BmBackend (normalizeDoclingPriceTablesResponse). Definitions are inlined (no $ref) for maximum provider compatibility.

filename.description: Provider/company short name in uppercase (ADX, ELEIA, TOTAL, GESTERNOVA, ENDESA, IBERDROLA, REPSOL, ...).

producto.description: One entry per commercial product/campaign in the document.

name.description: Product name as printed in the proposal, verbatim.

descuentoEnergiaPct.description: Total additive discount percentage to apply to ENERGY prices only (e.g. 20 for 10% bienvenida + 10% promocional). null when no discount applies. Never apply it yourself — always report base prices as printed.

unidadPotencia.description: Unit in which power prices are PRINTED in the document: €/kW·día, €/kW·mes, €/kW·año. NONE if no power prices exist. Values in preciosPotencia must be the printed numbers, unconverted.

unidadEnergia.description: Unit in which energy prices are PRINTED: €/kWh or cents (c€/kWh, cts). NONE if no energy prices exist. Values in preciosEnergia must be the printed numbers, unconverted.

tarifa.description: One entry per tariff type (2.0TD, 3.0TD, 6.1TD, ...). Power prices in the printed unit.

name.description: Tariff type normalized uppercase without spaces, e.g. 2.0TD.

tarifa.description: One entry per tariff type (2.0TD, 3.0TD, 6.1TD, ...). Energy prices in EUR/kWh (cents converted).

name.description: Tariff type normalized uppercase without spaces, e.g. 2.0TD.
